# mtncloud_load_balancer_pool (Data Source)

Looks up one pool of a load balancer by ID or by name, with its members and health monitor. Pick the load balancer by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

data "mtncloud_load_balancer_pool" "web" {
  network_id         = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  load_balancer_name = "web-lb"
  name               = "web-pool"
}

output "healthy_members" {
  value = [for m in data.mtncloud_load_balancer_pool.web.members : m.address if m.operating_status == "ONLINE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The pool's ID. Give this or `name`.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID. Give this or `load_balancer_name`.
- `load_balancer_name` (String) Load balancer name, matched exactly; it must match exactly one on the network. Give this or `load_balancer_id`.
- `name` (String) The pool's name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) How traffic is shared: `ROUND_ROBIN`, `LEAST_CONNECTIONS` or `SOURCE_IP`.
- `cookie_name` (String) Cookie used by `APP_COOKIE` persistence, or empty.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `health_monitor` (Attributes) The pool's health monitor, or null without one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_monitor))
- `listener_ids` (List of String) IDs of the listeners that use this pool.
- `members` (Attributes List) Backends, sorted by address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to the members: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `PROXY`, `PROXYV2`, `TCP` or `UDP`.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `session_persistence` (String) `SOURCE_IP`, `HTTP_COOKIE` or `APP_COOKIE` to keep a client on one member, or empty.
- `tls_enabled` (Boolean) Whether connections to the members use TLS.

<a id="nestedatt--health_monitor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_monitor`

Read-Only:

- `delay` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `expected_codes` (String) HTTP status codes that count as up, for example `200` or `200-204`, or empty.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method for `HTTP` and `HTTPS` checks, or empty.
- `id` (String) Health monitor ID.
- `max_retries` (Number) Successful checks in a row before a member is marked up.
- `max_retries_down` (Number) Failed checks in a row before a member is marked down.
- `name` (String) Health monitor name, or empty.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `pool_id` (String) ID of the pool it checks.
- `pool_name` (String) Name of the pool it checks.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds a check may take.
- `type` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `PING`, `TCP`, `TLS-HELLO` or `UDP-CONNECT`.
- `url_path` (String) Path requested by `HTTP` and `HTTPS` checks, or empty.


<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Backend IP address.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether it gets traffic only when every other member is down.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `id` (String) Member ID.
- `monitor_address` (String) Address the health monitor checks instead of `address`, or empty.
- `monitor_port` (Number) Port the health monitor checks instead of `port`, or 0.
- `name` (String) Member name, or empty.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `port` (Number) Backend port.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet the address is on, or empty for the load balancer's own.
- `weight` (Number) Share of traffic, 0 to 256; 0 sends it none.
